title: Meet Mimo — DevMimo intro
voice: Kokoro am_adam (kokoro-onnx), reference EQ, -14 LUFS master
music: warm pad (brand audio profile), ducked under the voice
mascot_note: Mimo is the brand's recurring character from brand/character/identity.json (same design as src/premium/Blob.tsx), drawn by src/devmimo/Mimo.tsx with the intro's animation controls. The on-screen name 'Mimo' comes from the DevMimo brief; identity.json public_name is unchanged.

scenes.narration: Ten thousand tutorials. And you're still stuck?
scenes.visual: Frame 0: an avalanche of tutorial tabs and a counter racing to 10,000. On 'stuck?' the stack freezes, a terminal error glitches through and STILL STUCK? slams in.
scenes.camera: slow push-in, hard freeze on the punch word

scenes.visual: The error terminal cracks open in accent light; Mimo pops out of the window, lands, blinks twice and waves. 'Meet Mimo' in serif + heavy sans.
scenes.camera: light burst, then a settle with a small overshoot

scenes.narration: Mimo takes real developer tools, and turns them into short builds you can actually follow.
scenes.visual: Tool chips fly into Mimo's hands, an editor types a short script, the result folds into a vertical build card with a progress bar.

scenes.narration: AI agents. MCP servers. Open-source repos worth your time.
scenes.visual: Three word-synced panels: an agent loop graph, an MCP hub with plugs snapping in, a repository tree that unfolds.
scenes.camera: whip between panels on each stressed word

scenes.narration: No fluff. Just the commands, the code, and why it works.
scenes.visual: FLUFF is struck through and crushed; a terminal checklist ticks commands, code and why it works as they are spoken.

scenes.narration: This is DevMimo. Follow along, and let's build something real.
scenes.visual: The DevMimo logo assembles (same animation as the 5 s logo sting); Mimo waves beside it; Follow along button pulses.

pacing.note: Instagram pacing pass: hook pulled forward, shorter reveal pause, faster topics, terminal kept readable, logo + CTA held >= 1.5 s.
